notes.text: The continuation imposes a transitivity condition for a composite and requires phi_u to be an isomorphism when u has the stated relation to underlined M. The low circle/o remains doubtful; the relation sign is visibly epsilon-shaped.
notes.basis: Observation: opening three lines and crops 01–02; no proof check.

notes.text: Item 3 asks for restriction and prolongation functors; restriction is to commute with inductive and projective limits, and prolongation is to be fully faithful with the stated essential image condition. The heading has plural restrictions and singular prolongement.
notes.basis: Observation: item 3 heading, display and continuation.

notes.text: Item 4 calls Res_X the right adjoint of Prol_X, specifies f^*=Res_X and f_!=Prol_X, then asks for preservation of abelian sheaves and a topos embedding. It calls the small topos equivalent to a subtopos of the large topos. The written reference is (9.1.1).
notes.basis: Observation and internal direction comparison only: item 4. No adjunction, embedding or preservation theorem was proved in this run.

notes.text: Item 5 asks for acyclicity after restriction of an abelian flasque sheaf and for the canonical cohomology comparison for F. The source has (V 4), plus the handwritten left-margin (V 4.1) attached after S(X)-acyclique. The capital O in M raised-O ntrer is physically raised.

Item 6 asks for the cohomology comparison for G with f_*G and Prol_X G in the larger topos. It says tout entier q without a visible range restriction. The discarded sur and (resp. are retained as deletions.
